name: Caps
summary: The fleet quota Caps already tracks, on the shelf
description: Caps reads /Users/lee/CC/Work/LFI/_ Operations/menubar-snapshot.json -- the same file Caps' menu-bar app and its Bartender line read -- and shows the fleet percentage as a small ring beside the notch, plus a shelf card with the overall number and each account's 7-day percentage for accounts whose week is not spent. Read-only, local file, no network, refreshed about once a minute.
